value.vedtektsfestetFormaal: Å avholde et årlig møte for nordiske urogynekologer og deres hjelpepersonell. Møtene avholdes hvert annet eller hvert år ettersom det sittende styre finner tjenlig. Møtene roterer i de nordiske land i følgende orden Sverige, Danmark, Norge, Finland og Island (hvert 9. år). Målet med møtene er å bidra til øket kunnskap og høyere kvalitet på diagnostikk og behandling av kvinnelig urinlekkasje og skjedeprolaps. Selskapet er et ideelt ikke profitt strebende vitenskapelig selskap. Et eventuelt overskudd vil bli utdelt til stipendier.
value.aktivitet: Ikke tjenestebasert virksomhet. NUGA består av et styre med urogynekolog fra hvert av de 5 nordiske land hvis eneste oppgave er å arrangere en faglig kongress for urogynekologer hvert 2. år samt gi ut priser og stipend til unge forskere innen urogynekologi.

external_observations.evidence_span: NUGA Sushi & Noodles Google profile: rating 4.6/5, 232 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Absolutely amazing food!! Couldn't believe I could get such good sushi in such a remote place.
We ordered the veggie spring rolls, veg tempura poke bowl and the veg rolls. All were presented well and very flavourful.
Be sure to reserve as they fill up fast.
Good service

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: I’d give 6 out of 5 if I could - book the restaurant in advance please you’d be grateful for your reservation as this is a really popular restaurant. With fresh seafood, a Japanese sushi and sashimi place is perhaps the best one you’d find here. Recommend their sashimi - fresh and simple - also their rolls - especially the special one.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: A little gem hidden in a hotel! I went here to try some Asian cuisine. I tried some fried noodles and a salmon sushi set. The food is excellent, and the vibe is nice. According to Svalbard’s customs, you need to take off your shoes before entering the restaurant.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Fantastic food. It was the best Japanese food I have eaten in months! Fantastic. What a very pleasant surprise

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
A really cool and tiny Japanese restaurant hidden in the back of a hotel.
On entrance you take of your shoes and leave them at the door and you walk past the hotel rooms to the restaurant. The restaurant seats about 20+ people. You get a menu you can scan and then call over the hostes for your order.
We got the Chicken and Pork Ramen, some Takoyaki and a couple sushi rolls. The broth in the ramens were good and the takoyaki tasted like the real deal, the sushi itself was very good as well, i recommend the Nuga Futomaki.
